newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Giant garoupa turns into fish steak in Hong Kong.
newsitem.headline: Giant garoupa turns into fish steak in Hong Kong.

text.p: A giant garoupa weighting 230 kg (500 lb) and believed to be more than 100 years old has been turned into fish steak by a Hong Kong restaurateur, a Hong Kong newspaper reported on Sunday.

The three-metre (10 ft) fish was killed at a restaurant in Causeway Bay, the British colony's main shopping district, on Saturday despite efforts by conservationists to save it, the South China Morning Post said.

The giant garoupa is a highly prized delicacy in the territory. The species used to be found in Hong Kong waters but after over-fishing it is now caught off the Philippine, Indonesian and Malaysian coasts.
